comment: Dr. Lipan is a great guy. The course is very challenging but definitely manageable with him. Sometimes lectures can get a little long because there is a lot of theory but not too bad. He grades heavily on tests but you can use hand written notes to help you.

Was expecting this class to be difficult from other reviews, but wasn't bad at all! Quizzes every other week, but can use any hand written notes. Exams are 4 questions but you need to understand the material even though notes can be used. The questions are not identical to previous problems. Definitely utilize his office hours and online resources!

I took quantum mechanics with him and we did not cover much. We touched on spin and the qualities of the harmonic oscillator but never actually solved the schrodinger equation. If you want an easy A, I would take any of his courses. But if you plan to go to grad school and take the PGRE, I would take upper level physics courses with someone else.

Dr. Lipan is passionate about teaching. He focuses on the idea that we should learn how to problem solve rather than simply memorize information. It takes some time to adjust to this teaching style. He assigns a manageable amount of work, acknowledges effort (when grading), and encourages participation/group work.

Dr. Lipan is a really good teacher, he wants students to try to figure out problems on their own but helps you along the way. He is great if you don't have the strongest physics background and understands when students are really trying, but if you want to major in physics he may not teach you the most. Also, his little anecdotes are so funny!

He was honestly brilliant. I personally have a strong background in physics and so it wasn't particularly challenging for me, although other people struggled. He truly enjoys his subject and he'll go out of his way to help you if you want it. He doesn't collect homework, but does quizzes based off the homework every week. (Had him for IQS)

The concepts in Optics Lab were complex, but rarely explained. Dr. Lipan studies Systems Biology and is ill-equipped to answer Optics questions. Our only grades for the majority of the semester were subjective evaluations of the professionalism of our lab reports. Dr. Lipan is smart and agreeable, but not a commendable teacher.

His quizzes and tests were extremely hard. His lectures explained the same problem for the entire time and were very confusing to follow. I went to extra help often but he would occasionally be annoyed that I didn't understand the concept and still had the same question because the concept was difficult

Dr. Lipan is an incredible professor who constantly seeks the best learning opportunities for his students. Yes, he does have an accent but after Day 1, I was totally used to it and able to understand him perfectly. Course material is very challenging, but he does a great job teaching the concepts. If you need PHYS 132, take it with Lipan for sure.

Definitely take this class.  HW is assigned but never collected and solutions are posted.  Quizes and Tests are straight forward.. Lets you use notes, HW, textbook, printouts, whatever for tests/quizzes and gives you all the time you want.  Overall though, great guy, really really nice, wants you to do well and like physics
Tough class. Hard to understand his teaching methods sometimes but overall, very nice guy.

he is a GREAT teacher. he is super funny, his class is relaxed. he tells lots of funny stories. i wish all my classes were this enjoyable. dont even consder taking other sections, his is the easiest by far. attending class was enjoyable

Ovidiu is one of the nicest people you will meet.  He is very willing to help and all his quizzes and tests are open-note. You have to pay attention because he is difficult to understand, but keep up with the homework and you will be fine.
he's a very nice person!! his class can get hard and frustrating, but that's physics, i think.

DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!  HE IS UNCLEAR ABOUT EVERYTHING.  For example, when he assigned extra credit, the majority of the class handed it in on the day of the final, JUST LIKE HE SAID, and he didn't take it because he claimed to have wanted it at a different time.  HIS CLASS IS CRAP!

he's a genius. very understanding of his students. very helpful outside of class. provides lots of extra credit opportunities to prove yourself. just keep up with the hw and work extra credit assgts, then an A will be smiling back at you from your transcript.
